DNSHijackWhitelist.description_en:
When a domain name (such as www.aliyun.com) is resolved, if the resolved IP address or CNAME is not in the DNS hijack whitelist, the user fails to access the domain name or a non-Alibaba Cloud destination IP address is returned. If the IP address or CNAME in the resolution result is in the DNS whitelist, DNS hijacking is considered not to have occurred.

Format: `Domain name:Matching rule`. Matching rules support IP addresses, IP wildcards, subnet masks, and CNAMEs. You can specify multiple matching rules separated by vertical bars (|). Example: `www.aliyun.com:203.0.3.55|203.3.44.67`, which indicates that all IP addresses other than 203.0.3.55 and 203.3.44.67 under the domain name www.aliyun.com are hijacked
DNSHijackWhitelist.description_zh:
域名（例如www.aliyun.com）解析时，解析出的IP地址或者CNAME不在DNS劫持白名单内，用户就会访问失败或者返回一个非Aliyun的目标IP；若解析结果中的IP或者CNAME在DNS白名单内，则会被认定为没有发生DNS劫持。

填写格式：`域名:匹配规则`。匹配规则支持IP、IP通配符、子网掩码和CNAME，可以填写多个匹配规则，多个匹配规则以竖线（|）隔开。例如：`www.aliyun.com:203.0.3.55|203.3.44.67`，表示www.aliyun.com域名下除203.0.3.55和203.3.44.67之外的其他IP都是被劫持的

PageTamper.description_en:
If elements outside the domain name settings appear on the monitored page, the page is considered tampered. Common forms include pop-up ads, floating ads, and redirects.

Format: `Domain name:Element`. Elements support wildcards. You can specify multiple elements separated by vertical bars (|). Example: `www.aliyun.com:|/cc/bb/a.gif|/vv/bb/cc.jpg`, which indicates that all elements other than the base document, /cc/bb/a.gif, and /vv/bb/cc.jpg under the domain name www.aliyun.com are considered page tampering
PageTamper.description_zh:

填写格式：`域名:元素`。元素支持填写通配符，可以填写多个元素，多个元素以竖线（|）隔开。例如：`www.aliyun.com:|/cc/bb/a.gif|/vv/bb/cc.jpg`，表示www.aliyun.com域名下除基础文档、/cc/bb/a.gif和/vv/bb/cc.jpg之外的其他元素都属于页面被篡改
